name: read_own_docs
description: Read FRED's own documentation to find out what FRED is and how it was built: the README, the plan, the handoff notes, the progress snapshots and the daily docs. With no name it lists what can be read; with a name or keywords it reads that document, one page at a time.

doc.description: which document: 'readme', a file name, or a few words from its path (progress, plan, brutal test); empty lists everything readable

page.description: which page of a long document to read (default 1)

examples: what are you and how were you built
what did the brutal test find
not_for: listing what FRED can do right now (use what_can_you_do)
